description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

Through some wicked twist of Chaos you no longer cast any reflection (in mirrors, shiny metal, puddles of water and so on), but you can make other people cast their reflection in you. With a successful Challenging (+0) Willpower Test, you can mask yourself as someone else, assuming their likeness in face and stature as well as clothing and voice, for the duration o Willpower + (SL x 10) minutes. You have to be familiar with the person and you can only impersonate people within the range of one step smaller or larger of your own Size. A fumbled roll will result in a @Table[minormis]{Minor Miscast}. You will automatically fool anyone who lacks the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.OEjUvJKi0xmBwbS2]{Second Sight} Talent, though some might notice that behaviours and mannerisms are different. People with @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.OEjUvJKi0xmBwbS2]{Second Sight} may roll for Perception to see if they notice anything, but they need to dispel the magic to see through it. Mirror Image doesnt automatically cause Fear in others (see @UUID[Compendium.artantares-mutations.journal.JournalEntry.uDGFazW9Nr0N6ABS.JournalEntryPage.9sK84Dvy3Ng36qXp#reactions-to-mutations]{Reactions to Mutations}), but revealing your ability - like someone seeing themself in you - might, and not casting any reflection will of course scare people. For each time you gain this mutation the duration is doubled.
